title: Treasury Operations — Counterparty & Dealer Exposure Limits

sections.heading: Interbank Money Market Limit
sections.body: Maximum overnight call/notice money borrowing limit is capped at 100% of capital funds on a fortnight average basis.

sections.heading: Derivative Counterparty Exposure
sections.body: Over-the-Counter (OTC) interest rate swap exposure to non-bank counterparties requires Credit Support Annex (CSA) collateral agreements.
